data.name: Divyanshay
data.gender_notes: Divyanshay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Divyanshay is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'divya' meaning divine and 'ansh' meaning auspicious or part. This name symbolizes the divine presence in an individual. The name Divyanshay carries the meaning “Divine, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Divyanshay usually hope their child will grow to embody divine, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Divyanshay belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine, Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Divyanshay total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

He is best known for his victory over the Muslim sultan Muhammad of Ghor at the Second Battle of Tarain in 1191, which marked a significant turning point in the history of the Indian subcontinent with the repulsion of the initial Muslim invasion.
